items.title: Home Depot CFO Richard McPhail to become retailer's next CEO
items.summary:
Home Depot (HD) announces that CFO Richard McPhail will step up to become the next CEO, replacing Ted Decker, effective November 23. Decker will serve in a new role as the company's chair.

The 8:30 Hosts Jake Conley, Julie Hyman, and Pras Subramanian discuss the significance of this headline reported alongside Home Depot's third quarter earnings results.

items.title: Home Depot (HD) Q3 Results Meet Growth But Margins Constrain Upside
items.summary: Home Depot entered this earnings release priced for resilience, not drama, after a flat few months and a modest 30-day gain of about 9%. Yet the stock dropped about 2.5% on the day as investors reacted to the Q3 2027 report and a premium P/E near 23.8x that already implied high expectations. The numbers themselves told a more measured story. Quarterly revenue reached about US$43.4b and basic earnings per share were approximately US$3.73.
